policy_scope.automatic_cross_provider_fallback: denied by overlay allowlist; no error-driven cross-provider failover found in the shared client factory
policy_scope.in_flight_request: provider/model/base_url/key resolution is taken from one caller/session snapshot; an existing client is not mutated to a newly saved provider
policy_scope.manual_provider_change: explicit owner-authorized reconfiguration, not silent fallback; config save notifies clients, closes the captured pre-save sessions using expected_session guards, then reloads configuration
policy_scope.post_change_rule: normal XiaoYu startup reruns the provider preflight; unknown/relay/router endpoints fail closed

order: capture and end the pre-save sessions with expected_session identity
source_audit.stale_session_guard: end_session(expected_session=...) preserves a replacement live session instead of tearing it down

decision: No fourth N.E.K.O core patch. Treat manual provider settings changes as an explicit owner reconfiguration boundary; silent/automatic drift remains fail-closed.
